adjacency_definition: Bounded differential privacy: two datasets D and D' differ by replacing at most one record (x, y) with (x', y'), where |D| = |D'|.
formal_guarantee: Record-level (epsilon, 0)-Differential Privacy via Diffprivlib LinearRegression (covariance matrix perturbation). Note: this protects individual half-hourly readings, not entire multi-year household time series.
